body.statement:
Under the declared Job Corps assignment, support, randomization, consistency, no-defiers, complier-conditional selection-monotonicity, and \(M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\ge m_*>0\) restrictions, let \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\), set \(p_0=p(P_0)\), and impose the declared relative-interior and tangent-image conditions.  The response-type fiber computes the separate same-law endpoints and proves
\[
\Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p_0)
\subseteq\prod_{t\in\mathcal T}
[\underline\Delta(t;p_0),\overline\Delta(t;p_0)],
\]
with no rectangle-equality claim.  The completed tangent cells define a lawful \(\mathfrak G_0\in\mathfrak E\) with certified nonempty \(H_{r_0}\).  The fixed-base compact transfer has the linear Carter--geometry--covariance modulus in \(\text{thm:fixed-stratum-transfer}\), and the qualitative moving-offset comparison is unconditional for any supplied Gaussian rule.  Construction of a finite replayable moving-offset Gaussian rule is conditional on the affirmative conclusion specified in \(\text{oeq:effective-compatible-density}\), or on a separately proved sufficient compatibility package; replayable comparison accounting also requires the stated effective finite-window enclosures to be supplied.  Under zero-offset centering, the diagonally selected expanding lawful windows satisfy
\[
M_n^{\diamond}\to M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0),
\qquad
\liminf_nM_n\ge M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0).
\]
The restricted singleton-\(\mathcal X\), perfect-compliance, finite-wage-grid submodel in \(\text{prop:bffl-discrete-perfect-compliance-embedding}\) embeds the Blanco--Flores--Flores-Lagunes always-employed comparison, but there is no unrestricted-class inclusion or automatic sharpness transfer.  No globally honest unbounded sampled-data primal, global \(\limsup_nM_n\), two-sided global multinomial minimax limit, or algorithmic diagonal-window selection is asserted.
body.justification: The proposition retains exact same-law causal identification, lawful tangent geometry, compact transfer, and conditional replayable Gaussian certification.
body.gap: A global unbounded sampled-data primal and global two-sided minimax convergence are no longer promised.
body.consumer: The workflow supports simultaneous ordered-wage assertions with an expanding-window sampled-data receipt and no rectangle-equality overclaim.
body.proof_tex:
\textbf{Technique: composition of exact finite-fiber identification, rational tangent geometry, compact experiment comparison, and the restricted published-model embedding.}

Let \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) and \(p_0=p(P_0)\).  The assignment, support, randomization, three consistency conditions, no-defiers, complier-conditional selection monotonicity, and aggregate target-positivity conditions are precisely the separately declared restrictions defining \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\).  In particular,
\[
M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\ge m_*>0,
\tag{57}
\]
so the conditional causal quantiles have a positive denominator.

By \(\text{thm:causal-label-polyhedralization}\), the observed-cell contrasts identify the selected-complier submeasures, and the finite response-type fiber is exactly the compatible full-law fiber.  For every fixed \(t\in\mathcal T\), \(\text{prop:lower-endpoint-attainment}\) and \(\text{prop:upper-endpoint-attainment}\) give same-law witnesses
\[
Q_{1,P_t^-(p_0)}(t)-Q_{0,P_t^-(p_0)}(t)
=\underline\Delta(t;p_0),
\tag{58}
\]
\[
Q_{1,P_t^+(p_0)}(t)-Q_{0,P_t^+(p_0)}(t)
=\overline\Delta(t;p_0).
\tag{59}
\]
For any one \(P\in\mathcal F(p_0)\), the definitions of infimum and supremum yield
\[
\underline\Delta(t;p_0)
\le Q_{1,P}(t)-Q_{0,P}(t)
\le\overline\Delta(t;p_0).
\tag{60}
\]
Taking all \(t\) and all compatible \(P\) proves the outer bound
\[
\Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p_0)
\subseteq\prod_{t\in\mathcal T}
[\underline\Delta(t;p_0),\overline\Delta(t;p_0)].
\tag{61}
\]
The witnesses in (58)--(59) may depend on both \(t\) and the endpoint, so (61) is not a Cartesian sharpness statement.

Under relative interiority and tangent-image compatibility, \(\text{prop:tangent-fan-global-cover}\) proves
\(\bigcup_{v\in V}D_v^0=\mathbb R^d\), with equality faces included in every incident label.  Since \(B\) has column rank \(d\) and \((p_0)_j\ge\kappa>0\), for nonzero \(z\),
\[
z'I_0z=\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}
\frac{\{(Bz)_j\}^2}{(p_0)_j}>0.
\tag{62}
\]
Thus \(I_0\succ0\) and \(\Sigma_0=I_0^{-1}\succ0\).  Rational \(p_0\) and \(B\) give rational \(\Sigma_0\).  The violated-row certificate in \(\text{prop:job-corps-radius-nonempty}\) proves \(H_{r_0}\ne\varnothing\).  These are exactly the cover, covariance, rational-encoding, and separated-domain conditions for
\[
\mathfrak G_0\in\mathfrak E.
\tag{63}
\]

The proved \(\text{thm:fixed-stratum-transfer}\) gives the compact linear modulus
\[
C_{2/\kappa}\frac{|\mathcal J|\log|\mathcal J|}{\sqrt n}
+(H_C+A_0)x_n(C)+\operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(C),
\tag{64}
\]
without assigning a root-\(n\) rate to the last two terms.  The proved \(\text{lem:moving-offset-carter-geometry}\) and \(\text{thm:moving-offset-transfer}\) give, for every supplied Gaussian rule on a fixed compact \(C\),
\[
C_{2/\kappa}\frac{|\mathcal J|\log|\mathcal J|}{\sqrt n}
+\operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(C)
+(H_C+2A_0)\overline\chi_n(C).
\tag{65}
\]
The sequences of actual and rationalized offsets lie in one fixed compact offset set because \(c_n\to c\) and \(\|\widehat c_n-c_n\|_\infty\to0\).  Hence the same finite \(H_C\) applies in (65).  The choice \(\overline\chi_n=\chi_n\) proves qualitative convergence.  A replayable finite Gaussian rule in (65) is available only under the affirmative effective-compatible-density conclusion or another sufficient package, and effective rational bounds for \(d_n(C)\) and \(\operatorname{Err}_{\Sigma,n}(C)\) must separately be supplied for replayable comparison accounting.

Under zero-offset centering, \(\text{thm:compact-exhaustion-transfer}\) gives the diagonally selected window conclusions
\[
M_n^{\diamond}\longrightarrow M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0),
\qquad
\liminf_{n\to\infty}M_n
\ge M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0).
\tag{66}
\]
Its diagonal argument proves existence of expanding lawful windows, not an algorithm for selecting them.

Finally, \(\text{prop:bffl-discrete-perfect-compliance-embedding}\) records the precise comparison with Blanco, Flores, and Flores-Lagunes.  On its singleton-\(\mathcal X\) restriction, perfect compliance gives
\[
D^{\mathrm{pot}}(1)>D^{\mathrm{pot}}(0)\quad\text{almost surely},
\tag{67}
\]
and \(s=+1\) turns monotone employment into the declared complier-conditional selection monotonicity.  Therefore
\[
\{D^{\mathrm{pot}}(1)>D^{\mathrm{pot}}(0),
S^{\mathrm{pot}}(0)=S^{\mathrm{pot}}(1)=1\}=EE,
\qquad M_{\mathrm{ASC}}=P(EE)\ge m_*>0.
\tag{68}
\]
Known rational assignment with \(\bar\pi_z\ge\pi_*\), randomized treatment, and the finite wage-grid restriction supply the remaining declared support and encoding requirements.  Thus this restricted law belongs to \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\).  Dropping perfect compliance, singleton support, the common assignment floor, or finite wage support leaves premises unmatched; consequently neither unrestricted class inclusion nor automatic transfer of a published sharpness result follows.

If effective compatible density is affirmatively resolved, conditional CertGluePFL applied to (63) yields the replayable Gaussian certificate; otherwise only the unconditional comparisons (64)--(66) remain.  The witness in \(\text{lem:escaping-boundary-kill}\) rules out deriving a global sampled-data upper limit from these compact premises.  This completes exactly the claimed identification, tangent, compact-transfer, diagonal-window, and conditional-certification conclusions.
